children: Japan's core consumer inflation, which excludes fresh food prices, is expected to hover near the central bank's 2% target in the six months through September 2027, even after accounting for the impact of planned sales tax cuts, SMBC Nikko Securities economists say. They project the gauge will fall below 1.5% in the second half of fiscal 2027. "While a consumption tax cut on food and beverages is expected to weigh on inflation from April 2027 onward, the pass-through of past import price increases to final consumer goods is likely to intensify through around next summer," they add. (megumi.fujikawa@wsj.com)
